priority_system: Tiered (Priority I A/B/C, II); 'shovel ready' projects chosen first for the initial grant
methane_or_gas_in_priority: Active gas flow with ignition danger
measurement_practice: Initial grant only through 2025 (no federal methane requirement); formula-grant plugging began late 2025
modeling_implication: Treat all KS values as missing (not measured); KS contributes to the selection model only
sources: IOGCC 2023 prioritization report; Stateline 2023-10-12 (Hoffman quote); KCC Federal Plugging Program page; DOI OIG Kansas inspection 2025-12

priority_system: Weighted points (Priority 1, 2H, 2, 3, 4); leaking wells automatically Priority 1
measurement_practice: Initial grant: no requirement; formula grant 2024-25: screen + measure; RRC publicly opposed the cost (Wright testimony 2024); share with a value fell from 0.58 to 0.09 after July 2025
data_pattern: 846 values; 99% zero; OGI is the only named method
modeling_implication: Zeros are OGI non-detects (limit 20-150 g/h) or unmeasured; value presence depends on date
sources: IOGCC 2023; RRC Wright testimony 2024-07-25; DOI revised guidance 2025-07

measurement_practice: On-site inspections only; no methane measurement found
modeling_implication: Selection model only
sources: IOGCC 2023; WOGCC initial grant abstract (HigherGov D22AP00237)

priority_system: Tiered (Categories 1-5: imminent threat to least risk)
measurement_practice: Before the program: methane tested only near buildings or for explosion risk; under federal funds: test, wait a few days, test, plug, test again
data_pattern: 1234 values; 97% zero; most with no method recorded
modeling_implication: Ask OCC what instrument and what a recorded 0 means; possible repeated-test averaging
sources: IOGCC 2023; Stateline 2023-10-12 (Skinner quote); Southwest Ledger (Wreath quote)

methane_or_gas_in_priority: Gas leaks explicitly scored; gas detectors used to pinpoint leaks
measurement_practice: KGS + Well Done Foundation measured 80-100 initial-grant wells (2022-24, chambers); results not in DOI layer
modeling_implication: KGS measurements are a separate, unused data source (request from KGS); DOI layer = selection only
sources: IOGCC 2023; UKY KGS project page; KGS fact sheet 2023

priority_system: Numeric (Priority 1 >30 ... 4 <=10); gas leak within 300 ft of a building = 32 pts
methane_or_gas_in_priority: Gas leaks scored; methane measurement added under IIJA
measurement_practice: Contractors: OGI survey then Semtech Hi-Flow on found leaks; LSU chambers on a subset (Driscoll 2025)
data_pattern: 665 values; values step in multiples of ~1.15 g/h (0.001 cfm resolution)
modeling_implication: Two-stage detection; interval-censor Hi-Flow values to 1.15 g/h steps
sources: IOGCC 2023; LSU CES OSR progress reports 2023-24; LSU white paper 2025

priority_system: Tiered by fluid leak rate (barrels/day); waterway proximity
measurement_practice: Initial grant: no measurement (1% with value); formula grant (2024+): 100% with value, all 0, no method
modeling_implication: All IL values look like placeholders; confirm with IDNR before using any
sources: IOGCC 2023; IDNR IIJA page; DOI press release 2024 (CO/IL/WV formula)

methane_or_gas_in_priority: Leaks of methane, oil, saltwater named
measurement_practice: Handheld 4-gas detector (Sensit Gold) per record
modeling_implication: 0 = not detected by a handheld LEL/ppm meter (very high limit); treat as weak left-censoring
sources: IOGCC 2023; DOI method strings

measurement_practice: Initial grant only; DOI report shows one 'methane detection test' photo; no protocol found
modeling_implication: Treat as missing
sources: IOGCC 2023; DOI FY2024 report to Congress; NOGCC initial grant abstract

measurement_practice: Committed in 2022 to quantify leakage before and after plugging; Semtech Hi-Flow 2 named; 'ND' strings
modeling_implication: Before/after design is good; 'ND' should be censored not zero
sources: IOGCC 2023; WVDEP initial grant abstract (HigherGov D22AP00164); DOI 2022 press release

priority_system: Numeric two-phase composite; 3200 ft from homes/schools; disadvantaged communities
measurement_practice: Committed in 2022 to before/after measurement; Hi-Flow 2 + RMLD-CS
modeling_implication: Hi-Flow detection model; RMLD records screening only
sources: IOGCC 2023; DOI 2022 press release; CalGEM expenditure plans 2023-24

measurement_practice: Federal guidelines cited; MGGA laser and Semtech named; separate state MERP program for marginal wells
data_pattern: 124 values (38%); 63% above 1 g/h; repeats at 1 and 5
modeling_implication: Many unmeasured; measured subset may be leak-selected
sources: IOGCC 2023; ECMC MERP and OWP pages

priority_system: Numeric Well Assessment Program; active leaks override; EJ score; grouping
measurement_practice: Formula grant (2024) requires measuring methane on plugged wells
modeling_implication: Split by funding period; zeros without method = placeholders
sources: IOGCC 2023; DOI FY2024 report; EGLE press releases

priority_system: Tiered: leaking and imminent danger first
measurement_practice: $5M small initial grant explicitly to 'support methane measurement'; data show none recorded
modeling_implication: Treat as missing; ask AOGC
sources: IOGCC 2023; DOI 2022 press release

priority_system: Numeric workbook; wells within 0.5 mi clustered into 8-12 well projects. BUT main federal program (OWPG, Act 96/136) pays licensed pluggers up to $40k/well, first come first served
measurement_practice: Plugger screens each well before applying (not detected / detected / detected + may be high); measure only if detected
modeling_implication: Selection is by pluggers (shallow, cheap wells), not state ranking; zeros = screening non-detects
sources: IOGCC 2023; PA DEP Orphan Well Plugging Grant page; PA DEP methane measurement page

methane_or_gas_in_priority: Leaking fluids and gases; wellhead pressure; methane considered
measurement_practice: Private entity measurement under review (2023); quarterly reports say methane considered via ranking
modeling_implication: Mostly placeholders; USGS Kevin-Sunburst dataset is a separate measured source
sources: IOGCC 2023; MT BOGC quarterly narratives FFY23; USGS data release 10.5066/P13A7RXN

priority_system: Numeric (30+ factors); active/historic leaks top priority; plugs whole areas
measurement_practice: Well Done Foundation: Ventbuster ultra-low flow meter + lab GC; pre-plug data USED TO PRIORITIZE plugging; some wells assigned a field average (e.g. 16 of 26 O'Brien wells measured, average applied to 10)
modeling_implication: Measurement precedes selection (selection on outcome); drop or down-weight field-averaged values
sources: IOGCC 2023; NM OCD well files (WDF technical memoranda 2023)

measurement_practice: Initial grant used to research methane protocols; water sampling within 500 ft
modeling_implication: Selection model only
sources: IOGCC 2023; DOI 2022 Ohio press release

measurement_practice: Pre-plugging emissions ESTIMATED from 2018 EPA study; DEQ to monitor a representative set after plugging (lacked equipment)
modeling_implication: Selection model only
